XunitTest.GenericStorageEmissionTest.Executes(name: \"Array\", source: \"struct Box<T>\\n    let value: T\\n    public init(value: T) => self.value = value@move\\n    public func take(self: Self) -> T => self.value@move\\nlet b = Box<[3 of i32]>.init([2, 4, 6])\\nvar total = 0\\nfor x in b@move.take() => total += x\\nrequire total == 12 else => $abort(\\\"array\\\")\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"ok\\\")\", stdout: \"ok\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericStorageEmissionTest.Executes(name: \"BoxDestruction\", source: \"struct Token\\n    let id: i32\\n    public init(id: i32) => self.id = id\\n    drop\\n        if self.id == 1 => Console.writeLine(\\\"one\\\")\\n        if self.id == 2 => Console.writeLine(\\\"two\\\")\\n        if self.id == 3 => Console.writeLine(\\\"three\\\")\\n        if self.id == 4 => Console.writeLine(\\\"four\\\")\\nstruct Box<T>\\n    let value: T\\n    public init(value: T) => self.value = value@move\\n    public func take(self: Self) -> T => self.value@move\\ndo\\n    let box = Box<Token>.init(Token.init(1))\\n    let value = box@move.take()\\n    Console.writeLine(\\\"taken\\\")\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"done\\\")\", stdout: \"taken\\none\\ndone\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericStorageEmissionTest.Executes(name: \"UnusedBox\", source: \"struct Token\\n    let id: i32\\n    public init(id: i32) => self.id = id\\n    drop\\n        if self.id == 1 => Console.writeLine(\\\"one\\\")\\n        if self.id == 2 => Console.writeLine(\\\"two\\\")\\n        if self.id == 3 => Console.writeLine(\\\"three\\\")\\n        if self.id == 4 => Console.writeLine(\\\"four\\\")\\nstruct Box<T>\\n    let value: T\\n    public init(value: T) => self.value = value@move\\n    public func take(self: Self) -> T => self.value@move\\nfunc choose<T>(a: T, b: T, first: bool) -> T => if first => a@move else => b@move\\ndo\\n    let box = choose(Box<Token>.init(Token.init(1)), Box<Token>.init(Token.init(2)), true)\\n    let value = box@move.take()\\n    Console.writeLine(\\\"taken\\\")\", stdout: \"two\\ntaken\\none\\n\")
